race.description: Dylans Final Freedom Stakes Provincial Mdn Hcp
race.comment: STAR OF INDIGO (2) has just found one better at her past couple of starts over this route. Doubt she has to do much more to go one better. SHIMANO (3) is a gelding by Russian Revolution for the Kris Lees yard who has trialled well here and warrants plenty of respect for the strong stable from a good draw. COLHEITAS (6) is a Portland Sky filly for the Brad Widdup yard who has won a trial here, Tommy Berry booked is a good lead and she is worth keeping safe. SPANISH DANCER (12) first-starter filly by Exceedance for the Brad Widdup stable. Has mixed trial from but worth a market watch for any confidence.
